blurb: Academy Ballroom Atlanta offers private and group ballroom dance lessons for all ages and skill levels, including social and competitive dancing. They provide practice dance parties, wedding classes, kids training, corporate events, and a dance attire boutique. The studio features three professional dance floors and over 10,000 sq ft of space in Buckhead Atlanta.
